articles.title: Meloni: 'Con Trump non mi pento di nulla, punto all'unità dell'Occidente'
articles.summary: Premier Meloni stated she regrets nothing about her political relationship with Trump and reaffirmed Italy's commitment to increase defense spending within NATO, while emphasizing Italy's refusal to participate in Iran attacks.

articles.title: Meloni: 'Un presidente della Repubblica di destra potrebbe non essere più un tabù'
articles.summary: Meloni suggested that if her coalition wins the next elections, a right-wing president of the Italian Republic could be possible, challenging traditional political norms.

articles.title: 'Diffamata da Corona', Giorgia Meloni pronta a testimoniare in aula a Milano
articles.summary: Meloni confirmed her availability to testify in Milan on September 28 in a defamation trial against Fabrizio Corona regarding false allegations published in 2023.

articles.title: Meloni attacca Vannacci: 'Fate il gioco della sinistra, altro che vera destra'
articles.summary: Meloni criticized Vannacci and Future National party in parliament, stating they act as an unwitting ally of the left and distancing them from the center-right coalition.

articles.title: Meloni: 'No alla patrimoniale, ridurre il carico fiscale sul ceto medio'
articles.summary: Meloni announced her government's fiscal policy opposition to wealth taxes while committing to reduce income tax burden on the middle class at a Confcommercio assembly.
